name: RIDI-PREDICT-v1
description: RIDI-PREDICT-v1 tests whether correctness changes in three small Qwen3 models under an independent grade-preserving retrieval exchange predict correctness changes in Qwen3-32B and OLMo-2-0325-32B-Instruct. Tokenizer-only preflight selected 800 fresh questions: 250 Natural Questions, 250 HotpotQA, and 300 FEVER. SciFact had no eligible fresh questions and was excluded under the prespecified rule. The design comprises 24 model-by-benchmark-by-draw units. No model responses have been generated for this study. Hypotheses, decision thresholds, exclusions, failure rules, and the analysis plan are specified in the attached protocol. The scientific lock will be published after registration and before generation. Parent registrations: https://osf.io/txwdv/, https://osf.io/ms4w8/, and https://osf.io/whjbs/.
